description: Enrich PaymentAuditLog entity with TransactionStatus/CustomerEmail/SessionId, generate EF migration, and update all three payment handlers (CreateDodoSessionCommandHandler, VerifyDodoPaymentCommandHandler, ProcessDodoWebhookCommandHandler) to record status/email on every payment lifecycle event. Also add GetPaymentTransactionsQuery, its handler, the PaymentTransactionDto, and the new GET /api/payments/transactions controller endpoint.
steps: 1. In backend/ranker/Domain/Entities/PaymentAuditLog.cs, add three new properties after the existing Currency field: `public string? TransactionStatus { get; set; }`, `public string? CustomerEmail { get; set; }`, `public string? SessionId { get; set; }`.

2. In backend/ranker/Data/Configurations/PaymentAuditLogConfiguration.cs, add inside Configure(): `builder.Property(l => l.TransactionStatus).HasMaxLength(20);`, `builder.Property(l => l.CustomerEmail).HasMaxLength(254);`, `builder.Property(l => l.SessionId).HasMaxLength(150);`, `builder.HasIndex(l => l.CustomerEmail);`, `builder.HasIndex(l => l.SessionId);`.
3. Run from backend/ranker/: `dotnet ef migrations add AddTransactionStatusToPaymentAuditLog --context RankerDbContext`. Verify the generated Up() adds the three columns and two indexes.

4. In backend/ranker/Application/Payments/CreateDodoSessionCommandHandler.cs, update the success-path PaymentAuditLog initializer to set `TransactionStatus = "Pending"`, `CustomerEmail = command.CustomerEmail`, `SessionId = sessionId`. Update the catch-path PaymentAuditLog to set `TransactionStatus = "Failed"`, `CustomerEmail = command.CustomerEmail`.

5. In backend/ranker/Application/Payments/VerifyDodoPaymentCommandHandler.cs, after every return path (existingClaim early return, payment not found, non-succeeded, succeeded+claim placed, succeeded+claim rejected), add a PaymentAuditLog write to dbContext and SaveChangesAsync(ct). Set Action="VerifyPayment", PaymentId=paymentId, SessionId=command.SessionId, CustomerEmail from payment.CustomerEmail (or ownerEmail once extracted), Amount and Currency from payment object, TransactionStatus mapped from payment.Status ("succeeded"->"Succeeded", "failed"->"Failed", "pending"->"Pending", "cancelled"->"Cancelled", other->"Unknown"), IsSuccess based on payment.Status=="succeeded". For the existingClaim early-return path, set TransactionStatus="Succeeded", IsSuccess=true, CustomerEmail=existingClaim.PaymentReference (not ideal, skip email here). Note: dbContext is already injected via primary constructor.

6. In backend/ranker/Application/Payments/ProcessDodoWebhookCommandHandler.cs, add private static helper `ExtractCustomerEmail(JsonElement root)` that navigates root->"data"->"customer"->"email" returning string? null if missing. Update the audit object construction: set `PaymentId = actualPaymentId` (use the result of ExtractPaymentId already called above in each event branch, stored in a local var), `TransactionStatus` via switch on eventType ("payment.succeeded"->"Succeeded", "payment.failed"->"Failed", "payment.cancelled"->"Cancelled", _->"Unknown"), `CustomerEmail = customerEmail` (from new helper).

7. In backend/ranker/Dtos/PaymentDtos.cs, add at the end: `public sealed record PaymentTransactionDto(int Id, string Action, string? TransactionStatus, string? PaymentId, string? SessionId, string? OrderId, decimal? Amount, string? Currency, bool IsSuccess, string? ErrorMessage, DateTime CreatedAt);`

8. Create backend/ranker/Application/Payments/GetPaymentTransactionsQuery.cs: `public sealed record GetPaymentTransactionsQuery(string Email) : IRequest<IReadOnlyList<PaymentTransactionDto>>;` with using Ranker.Dtos and MediatR.

9. Create backend/ranker/Application/Payments/GetPaymentTransactionsQueryHandler.cs: handler implementing IRequestHandler<GetPaymentTransactionsQuery, IReadOnlyList<PaymentTransactionDto>>. Inject RankerDbContext dbContext. Query: dbContext.PaymentAuditLogs.Where(l => l.CustomerEmail == query.Email && l.TransactionStatus != "Succeeded").OrderByDescending(l => l.CreatedAt).Take(100).Select(l => new PaymentTransactionDto(l.Id, l.Action, l.TransactionStatus, l.PaymentId, l.SessionId, l.OrderId, l.Amount, l.Currency, l.IsSuccess, l.ErrorMessage, l.CreatedAt)).ToListAsync(ct). Return result as IReadOnlyList<PaymentTransactionDto>.

10. In backend/ranker/Controllers/PaymentsController.cs, add method: `[HttpGet("transactions")] public async Task<ActionResult<IReadOnlyList<PaymentTransactionDto>>> GetTransactions([FromQuery] string email, CancellationToken ct)`. Validate email not empty, send GetPaymentTransactionsQuery(email), return Ok(result). Add using Ranker.Dtos at top if not already present.
acceptance_criteria: Running `dotnet build backend/ranker/ranker.csproj` from the repo root exits 0 with no errors.

A new migration file exists at backend/ranker/Migrations/<timestamp>_AddTransactionStatusToPaymentAuditLog.cs containing Up() that adds TransactionStatus, CustomerEmail, SessionId columns and indexes.
PaymentAuditLog entity has TransactionStatus, CustomerEmail, SessionId properties.
CreateDodoSessionCommandHandler sets TransactionStatus='Pending' on success and 'Failed' on exception.
VerifyDodoPaymentCommandHandler writes a PaymentAuditLog row on every code path.
ProcessDodoWebhookCommandHandler sets PaymentId to the actual payment ID (not webhookId) and sets TransactionStatus.
GetPaymentTransactionsQueryHandler returns only rows where TransactionStatus != 'Succeeded' for the given email.
GET /api/payments/transactions?email=test@example.com is a valid endpoint that compiles and is reachable.
